blocks.x: AI-enabled smart vision glasses for the visually challenged, and assistive devices for elderly care.

Driisti Smart Vision Glasses operationalizes AI governance: the policy layer (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act mapping), model registry with technical documentation, evaluation suites with red-team suites, guardrail configuration, incident response for AI events, and the evidence pack that turns conformity assessment into a formality. Compass is where AI programs stop being risky: every model carries its model card, its evaluation results, its guardrail configuration and its control owner. High-risk use cases (credit scoring, employment, medical) get the documentation, human-oversight and post-market monitoring the EU AI Act actually requires — built in, not bolted on.

blocks.x: Compass treats governance as system behavior: policies versioned, evaluations gated in CI, incidents tracked to closure with owners. The output is an AI estate your CISO defends to the board and your regulator inspects without expeditions.

Driisti Smart Vision Glasses runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Insurance & Risk, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: Driisti Smart Vision Glasses baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
